dct_description_sm:
The Active Planning Applications data provides information on proposed development applications for the City of Kingston Planning Area and is intended to provide an overview of each. This data is included in the Planning and Development Map web application.

For more information, please contact the Planning & Development Department located at 1211 John Counter Boulevard, Phone: 613-546-4291.
